msg: A JDBC user lookup does not belong in a class-path utility class (unrelated responsibility, new java.sql dependency).
Fallback still throws NumberFormatException for values with a fraction or exponent; intValue() should go through BigDecimal.
longValue() fallback uses new BigInteger(value), which throws for decimal/exponent strings.
'pinia && activePinia' should be '||': no fallback to activePinia outside an injection context.
const pathname is reassigned below ('/index.html'): TypeError for '/'.
Condition inverted ('!== true'): non-true values return IDNA_DEFAULT and the is_int branch is unreachable.
Only functions with an explicit ABSTRACT modifier are counted; bodiless interface functions are implicitly abstract.
Chunk appended after readEscapeCharacter(), which can refill/shift the buffer; start/len may no longer be valid.
Stray assignment to field initialLength looks like leftover code.
Removed guard for an invalid $callablePattern: preg_match fails silently and Class:method is misresolved.
Same removed guard in the middleware dispatcher.
'&&' became '||': every Class reported primitive; non-Class types throw ClassCastException.
'index <= endIndex' reads one past the slice.
i <= len(s) indexes s[len(s)]: panic.
'&&' should be '||': backwards seeks no longer reopen the stream.
Precision from toString().split('.') breaks for exponent-form doubles and NaN/Infinity; %L now reformats every Number.
'&&' contradicts the 'or' comment: delimiter missing when only file completion follows.
'split' no longer local but still assigned by _init_completion -s: leaks into the user's shell.
Condition inverted: configured max age now returns None; timedelta branch dead.
Fallback uses the same MouseEvent constructor that just threw, so the catch path throws again.
Origin check inverted: same-origin links go through the CORS path.
Condition inverted: offset suffix written only for UTC, omitted for other zones.
Interface method with a body must be default or static: does not compile; unrelated to the interface's purpose.
Removing public checkNotNull breaks external callers the removed comment warned about.
Depends on the private Werkzeug 3.x signature of _update_cookies_from_response; minimum Werkzeug version must be bumped.
'<= 0' rejects valid read(0); message still says negative.
'and' became 'or': IndexError on args[0] when called without positional args.
Condition inverted: else branch dereferences a null operator.
'<= 500' runs the digest retry on HTTP 500.
hostname is lower-cased/None: case-sensitive netrc entries stop matching; None host may raise.
Eager socket.outputStream in the sink constructor throws for unconnected/closed sockets.
Eager socket.inputStream in the source constructor throws for unconnected/closed sockets.
Condition inverted: validation skipped when a validator exists, nil panic otherwise.
'&&' became '||': closes non-resources on PHP 7.
Promise never resolves after a file is selected.
Found template no longer returned in explain mode: always TemplateNotFound.
A users-table lookup does not belong in routing middleware.
'i <= length()' reads past the end for all-digit versions: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Null check removed: switch on null throws NPE despite the 'null if unknown' contract.
null treated as EPOCH makes toMillisSince(null) silently return decades of millis.
Javadoc says not null while null is now accepted.
c.Keys read without c.mu: races with concurrent Set (concurrent map read/write).
Message uses $this instead of $path.
dir / entry.toString() duplicates the directory prefix; use entry.fileName.
Non-generic types now become a ParameterizedTypeName without arguments.
Invalid XML returns false; withParsedBody(false) throws (PSR-7 requires null|array|object).
itsdangerous signs with the last key: fallbacks appended after secret_key make new sessions use an old key; current key must be last.
Missing key in initialState overwrites the ref with undefined.
Error check removed: unused err (compile error) and lost os.Create failure.
Argument validation error thrown as RequestException; should be InvalidArgumentException.
